exploit_name: Token callback reentrancy in claim, withdraw, and create
description: StakingBase._claim() and _withdraw() violate CEI by calling the virtual _transfer() function before updating persistent balance state. The virtual function can invoke token callbacks or receiver fallbacks, enabling reentrancy.
attack_scenario: Attacker calls withdraw which triggers _transfer callback. During callback, attacker reenters to claim or withdraw again. State not yet updated from first call, so full balance is available for second extraction.
root_cause: StakingBase._claim() and _withdraw() violate CEI by calling the virtual _transfer() function before updating persistent balance state. The virtual function can invoke token callbacks or receiver fallbacks, enabling reentrancy.
fix_description: Apply reentrancy guards to claim/withdraw/create. Reorder external interactions to follow CEI strictly.
notes: Overlapping withdrawals can drain contract funds. Corrupted balance accounting. Complete or partial fund loss.
